instruction: A cinematic full shot of three friends celebrating joyfully in a sunny park. On the left, the woman in the dark blue t-shirt (R4) jumps on her toes to high-five her companions. In the center, the bald man in the dark blue t-shirt (R2) laughs heartily with his hands raised in the air. On the right, the large Black man in the dark t-shirt (R1) leans forward with his arms outstretched in a triumphant gesture. They stand close together on the vibrant green grass under the shade of mature trees, illuminated by bright, warm daylight.
